zoe-marketing: Quick one — tiny bench ask for launch social card copy. Need reproducible latency numbers for embed+rerank to justify the headline.

zoe-marketing: Ask: run a compact sweep (150 samples) comparing fp32 vs int8 on rwin-open-7b; want p50/p90/p99 and one representative rerank example showing order preserved. Warmup included.

ali-runtime: Got it. Any constraints on payload lengths?

zoe-marketing: Mix ~60% short (<100 tokens) and 40% medium (300-600 tokens). include KV-cache interactive hits (10 samples) to show cached speedup.

sam-devex: Please tag traces with tag=launch-social and sample_tag so we can map to analytics. Also add warmup=true/false annotation.

troy-eng: Timeline: we can spin a smoke run tonight and full sweep tomorrow afternoon. Smoke will include one annotated rerank example and p99 snapshot.

zoe-marketing: smoke by tomorrow 9am would be ideal. If full sweep slips, ship smoke artifacts so we can lock copy.

bench-bot: Job queued — id=50231, queue=staging-bench, variants=[rwin-open-7b-fp32,rwin-open-7b-int8], cohort=150, longpct=40. ETA smoke: 2024-06-20T02:30Z.

ali-runtime: Repro command: run_bench --cohort launch_social_pack.json --models rwin-open-7b-fp32 rwin-open-7b-int8 --warmup 25 --samples 150 --trace-tags "campaign=launch-social" --output artifacts/2187659999-smoke.tar.gz

ali-runtime: We'll include per-request latencies, a README with git/model shas and instance SKU, and one slide-ready rerank prompt/response pair (scrubbed).

zoe-marketing: Perfect — thanks. Ping here when smoke artifacts are ready so design can iterate.
